To: jan.thornton@mailbox.example, pete.thornton@mailbox.example, carol.rigby@mailbox.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Caravan 2027 costs and weeks

Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2027 has come in at £5,087 all in. Split four ways, same as always, that is £1,271.75 each. I know it has gone up again, nearly £350 on last year, but there is nothing I can do about it as the park sets it.

Please can you get your share to me by 31 January, into the same account as before, as the park wants it all by then. If anyone would rather pay in two lots that is fine, £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January. Just let me know which you are doing.

The weeks are as follows and there are no clashes this year.

Pete and Linda: 29 May to 5 June (May half term)
Me and Bev: 5 to 12 June, with handover on Saturday 5 June
Jan: 7 to 14 August
Carol: Easter and a week in September, we can sort the exact dates between us

Pete, you mentioned the shower tray. I went up on 26 October and put a new one in. The parts were £140 but I am not putting that on the bill, it is done.

Please can everyone make sure the water is turned off at the stop tap when you leave. The park has moaned about it again.

One more thing so nobody is surprised. The park says caravans over 15 years old will need a condition survey before the 2028 season. Ours is 16, so that will apply to us next year. I will let you all know more when I have it.

Any problems give me a shout.

Regards
Mick
